_comment_fixture: Complex flow control: a SequenceRootContainer with TWO DeepSkyObjectContainer children (multi-target night) AND a ParallelContainer carrying a watchdog trigger. The first target uses a TimeCondition (run until a wall-clock ISO timestamp) instead of an iteration count. The second target uses LoopForeverCondition. This fixture pins structural fidelity: containers nest, triggers append after items, and the condition-folding logic surfaces _loopUntilTime / _loopForever on the parent canonical node.
Name: Two-target night with time conditions

Items._comment_target_1: First target loops until a wall-clock time (TimeCondition.DateTime in ISO-8601). The fold logic should surface this as _loopUntilTime on the parent's attributes.
Items.Name: M81 Bode

Conditions._comment_time_condition: TimeCondition: stop at this UTC ISO timestamp.

Items._comment_target_2: Second target uses LoopForeverCondition. The fold logic should set _loopForever=true so the mapper produces LoopNode(conditionType: forever) when the parent is reclassified as a loop. Note the DeepSkyObjectContainer doesn't become a loop in the current mapper — _loopForever is dropped on a targetHeader. That's documented as a known gap.
Items.Name: M82 Cigar

Items._comment_parallel: ParallelContainer: two child branches that run side-by-side. Skotiq has a ParallelNode for this.
Items.Name: Imaging + Dome

Items._comment_loop_count: Inner loop with iteration count (the common case).
Items.Name: M82 Light Frames

Items._comment_dither_branch: Second branch — purely demonstrative; a dither alongside the loop. (Real NINA users put dome-status checks here but those types aren't yet supported by Skotiq.)
Items.Name: Periodic Dither
